description:
Correct contributor documents that present the `git2` crate as jit's git integration.

## Background

- `dev/vision/document-viewer-implementation-plan.md:597` says "`git2` crate - Already integrated for git operations".
- `dev/vision/knowledge-management-vision.md` plans git integration through `git2-rs` (`dev/vision/knowledge-management-vision.md:123`, `:130`, `:352`, `:539`).
- Git access goes through one storage-owned module that runs the git CLI (`@/charter/D-21`). `dev/archive/`, `dev/benchmarks/` and `dev/active/` hold records and stay as written.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Those five passages describe git access through the git CLI module (`@/charter/D-21`) or are marked as superseded, and no document under `dev/` outside `dev/archive/`, `dev/benchmarks/` and `dev/active/` presents git2 or libgit2 as the current integration.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Contributor documents stop presenting libgit2 as the git integration
